messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: GMRFLib
parts:
GMRFLib Is entirely contained in the INLA project and can be found in the google code repository. Everything in INLA (except for the SPDE stuff) is built from GMRFLib.

As for an R wrapper, I don't think we have plans to do that, but it is an open source project, so you could always write your own :D

/Dan

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: GMRFLib
parts:
Ah. I see now. It is stll a separate library, but it is deployed "next to" INLA, r-INLA and fmesher.

Structurally, INLA depends on GMRFLib and fmesher, which are independent. They are, however, maintained together.

I don't believe the docs you referenced above are up to date, but you can run doxygen on the google code source to get the most up to date ones.

D
